etymologies.etymologyHTML: Equivalent to it +‎ -s (possessive marker). From the earlier form it's (it +‎ -'s), which is now considered nonstandard. Began to displace his as the possessive of the neuter pronoun in the Middle English period; had fully displaced it by the 1700s.
